Usage: gs stack (s) reorder <branches> ...

Reorder a stack without an editor

Reorder a linear stack without opening an editor. Provide every branch from
closest to trunk to furthest from trunk.

For example:

    gs stack reorder foundation api docs tests

Arguments:
  <branches> ...    Branches from bottom to top

Global Flags:
  -h, --help           Show help for the command
      --version        Print version information and quit
  -v, --verbose        Enable verbose output ($GIT_SPICE_VERBOSE)
  -C, --dir=DIR        Change to DIR before doing anything
      --[no-]prompt    Whether to prompt for missing information
